thread:
maya: FYI support case #2341 — customer reporting consistent mid-stream disconnects on SSE. They get partial output then client reconnects. Happens on mobile + hotspot. Suspect ISP NAT rebind. Attaching snippets below.

ben_oncall: Thanks — is this hosted API or Dedicated? any region?

maya: hosted (us-east-1). route is /v1/stream. client sends periodic app-level pings every 60s. token TTL 300s. partial output looks like last chunk then connection closes.

maya: log excerpt from client (trimmed):
```
[2026-01-21T14:22:10Z] RECV chunk: {"text":"...partial..."}
[2026-01-21T14:22:18Z] socket error: ECONNRESET
[2026-01-21T14:22:18Z] reconnecting, resume_token=abc123
```

carla: Can you pull the edge/proxy logs for that timeframe? Need to know whether we saw a TCP FIN/RST or if upstream closed. Also paste any client IP changes seen.

maya: edge logs:
```
2026-01-21T14:22:16Z edge-conn-id=78fd CLOSED by client src=35.218.12.9:52344 -> dst=13.52.45.10:443
2026-01-21T14:22:17Z upstream reset: write failed: connection reset by peer
2026-01-21T14:22:17Z new conn from 100.96.12.5:34567
```

mike_net: IPs show a switch from 35.218.x (public wifi/hotspot) to 100.96.x (carrier NAT/CGNAT). That's a classic NAT rebind during mobile handover. When the 5-tuple changes the NAT mapping drops and TCP closes. Client sees partial frame then ECONNRESET.

mike_net: Mitigations: shorter app-level ping interval (10s), enable resume tokens on stream (so client can ask server to continue from last emitted token), or enable session stickiness / UDP-friendly handover at edge. Also consider TCP keepalive on the client at OS level (but clients often can't tune this).

jess_support: Can you paste repro steps we can give the customer? we'll try to reproduce with a test device.

maya: Repro steps I gave customer: 1) start SSE stream on mobile while on home Wi‑Fi, 2) enable hotspot on another phone and move device to hotspot or toggle cellular, 3) wait 10–30s while stream is active, 4) observe partial output then reconnect. They said it happens ~70% of attempts.

carla: On the server side I looked at the stream session metadata. resume support (allow_resume) was disabled for this customer's plan. If we enable prefix resume + small-response caching, the UX would be: after reconnect client requests resume_token and server resends the tail. Could enable as a config toggle for a limited customer set.

ben_oncall: Any immediate server-side knobs we can flip without a deploy? e.g., increase proxy idle->keepalive time or adjust upstream drain.

carla: We can temporarily reduce server read timeout to detect dead TCP earlier and surface a 499-ish code rather than letting the connection linger. But that won't stop NAT rebind. Best short-term: reduce our required app ping interval (accept pings every 15s) and add a server-side small-window prefix cache so clients can recover missing tokens. That requires a minor config change (no code).

oncall-bot: Deploy job queued: keepalive-policy -> aggressive-canary (ping 60s -> 15s) on the edge pool for canary customers. CI check passed.

mike_net: :thumbsup: Also recommend we update docs for mobile clients: suggest websocket/SSE ping <= 15s and implement exponential reconnect with resume token.

jess_support: I'll send the repro steps + suggested client change to the customer and ask permission to enable allow_resume for them. Also flag for billing: enabling resume may increase token retention — need to confirm cost impact.

maya: Customer id 87654. They agreed to allow us to toggle resume for a trial window.

carla: Toggle done for cust=87654. I'll monitor logs for 30m. Starting canary keepalive change now.

mike_net: After flip we'll look for fewer ECONNRESET reports and more clean reconnects with resume_token exchanges.

maya: Customer updated: they tested once and reported stream recovered w/ resumed tail. We'll keep monitoring. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:

ben_oncall: Captured for postmortem checklist: - Mobile NAT rebind = known cause - Recommend docs update - Offer resume toggle for affected customers - Edge keepalive policy tuning - Add a small 'resume' flag in onboarding checklist.

jess_support: I'll open a follow-up ticket for docs + billing note.

maya: closing the thread after 2h of monitoring if stable.
